LSO.note: The document says nothing about a link between Lesotho's civil register and ID system.
No count or share of Lesotho's population holding a national ID is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned for Lesotho.
Who operates or maintains Lesotho's ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the Lesotho ID number is named.

facts.fact: Co-Develop and FinMark Trust state that in a pilot Lesotho migrants in South Africa accessed formal remittance services using their national digital IDs, verified in real time across the border.
